content: Mapping of software sections to memory Type: valid Description: Parts of software (code, data) shall be map-able to specific memory areas. Rationale: Each software consists of several sections which are defined when developing/compiling the software. Those sections need to be placed in different memory areas on the ECU. Use Case: • If data shall be post-build configurable it needs to be placed in non-volatile memory. The location the data is placed is needed for tools to be able to change the data later on. • Certain SW variables have to be placed in a NOINIT memory area which will not be initialized during ECU start-up. Dependencies: Software needs to publish the memory sections that have been used while developing/compiling the software. This needs to be part of the BSWMD [12] and the SWC-T [13]. Supporting Material: Specification of Memory Mapping [14]
